summary: Free-form thought logs are insufficient for AI agents performing complex multi-step reasoning. Existing Sequential Thinking MCP only provides unstructured text, lacking typed kinds, branching, revision tracking, dependencies, evidence references, risk classification, and budget enforcement.

text: Build a Rust stdio MCP server exposing the sequentialthinking tool with 12 typed thought kinds, branching, revisions, dependencies, evidence, risk, and action proposals
Expose 6 MCP tools: sequentialthinking, sequential_thinking (alias), get_thinking_session, list_thinking_sessions, clear_thinking_session, export_thinking_session
Enforce configurable budgets (32 thoughts, 8 branches, 12 revisions, 4000 chars content, 10 evidence, 20 tags)
Redact 10+ secret patterns before storage and logging; metadata-only logging by default
Accept legacy Sequential Thinking input format and map to structured fields
Export session traces in JSON, JSONL, and Markdown formats
Ship with full test suite (10 categories), README, and pinned Cargo.toml dependencies
All 6 MCP tools registered and functional over stdio
12 thought kinds, 7 statuses, 5 branch statuses, 5 risk levels, 10 risk categories implemented
All 7 budget types enforced with correct default values
10+ secret patterns redacted with redactBeforeStore and redactBeforeLog enabled
JSON, JSONL, and Markdown export returning correct output
All 10 test categories passing; cargo clippy clean; cargo fmt passing
Cargo.toml has zero wildcard dependency versions
stdio MCP server binary
6 MCP tools with typed schemas and annotations
In-memory session store with Arc<RwLock<HashMap<...>>>

reason: Official Rust MCP SDK; handles stdio transport, tool registration, and JSON-RPC
impact: All tool handlers and server bootstrap depend on rmcp API

text: Use Arc<RwLock<HashMap<...>>> for in-memory store
reason: Simple, correct, no extra dependency; acceptable for single-process stdio server
impact: Store trait implementation uses this pattern

text: Use ephemeral retention with opportunistic cleanup
reason: Matches privacy requirements; no background task complexity
impact: cleanup_expired called at start of every tool invocation

text: Use snake_case for serde enums, camelCase for struct fields
reason: Standard Rust convention for enums; standard JSON convention for fields
impact: Every serialized type must use correct serde rename

text: Default branch is 'main' when none provided
reason: Matches single-reasoning-path default; explicit branching is opt-in

text: sequential_thinking is a tool alias calling same handler
impact: Tool registration registers both names to same handler

text: Content redacted before storage AND logging
reason: Defense in depth; secrets should never be stored or logged
impact: Redaction runs at step 8 in validation pipeline

text: rmcp API is incompatible with our data model
mitigation: Use Context7 to verify rmcp API before implementation; wrap rmcp types if needed

text: Redaction regexes produce false positives
mitigation: Use conservative patterns with word boundaries; log redaction counts but not content

text: Budget exhaustion during critical reasoning
mitigation: Allow final_decision after budget exceeded; make budgets configurable

text: Arc<RwLock<HashMap<...>>> contention under concurrent access
mitigation: stdio is single-client; only concurrent if MCP client sends pipelined requests

text: Legacy compatibility mode misinterprets modern fields
mitigation: Only activate legacy normalization when thought field is present and kind is absent

text: schemars JSON Schema generation differs from hand-written schemas
mitigation: Verify generated schemas against spec examples

text: TTL expiration race condition
mitigation: Check expiration at start of every tool call; accept small race window
